:::{#exr-hyperplane-graph-practice}
#### Finding the normal vector of the graph of a regression surface

@thm-hyperplane-graph says that the [graph](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-graph)
of $\vx \mapsto \dprod{\vw}{\vx} + b$ is a [hyperplane](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-hyperplane) in $\reals^{p+1}$.
Let $f(x_1, x_2) = 3 x_1 - x_2 + 2$, a regression surface with two features.

Find a [normal vector](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-normal-vector) for the graph of $f$ in $\reals^3$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Read off $\vw$ and use the [normal vector](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-normal-vector) $\sbmat{\vw \\ -1}$ from @thm-hyperplane-graph.

:::

:::
